radio.dialHint: Drag the needle, or use the arrow keys
radio.endCorrectIndependent1: One last letter: "Found the key. The door opened."
radio.endCorrectIndependent2: "But I keep thinking it isn't the one she left me."
radio.endCorrectLinked1: One last letter: "The clerk said it was just a cola."
radio.endCorrectLinked2: "I sat at the door till morning. Maybe there never was a key."
radio.endKeepIndependent1: One last letter: "There are two keys now."
radio.endKeepIndependent2: "Our house has one door. Tonight, someone came home on both sides."
radio.endKeepLinked1: One last letter: "I got the key. The door was open, the lights were on."
radio.endKeepLinked2: "My sister was waiting inside. She looks exactly like me."
radio.ferry1: Crossing report, Lowtide to the far shore. Sea slight. Visibility good.
radio.ferry2: The 03:40 sailing is running on time.
radio.intro1: This is FM 87.6, Night Ferry. I'm June.
radio.intro2: One a.m. Good evening to everyone still awake.
radio.linesOpen: Phone lines are open for the rest of the night. Call in and tell us who's still up.
radio.o1: Rain until dawn. The ferry's suspended — hang in there, dock crew.
radio.o2: A listener requested an old song for the night clerk at the corner store.
radio.o3a: The old relay tower across the bay has been dead for twelve years.
radio.o3b: But on rainy nights, people swear they hear it transmitting.
radio.o4: Lost and found: one yellow rain boot at the pier. Left foot.
radio.o5b: "I left the spare key at Harbor Mart. My sister will pick it up."
radio.o6a: Sorry — the signal got messy for a moment.
radio.o6b: If you heard another station, that wasn't us.
radio.o7: Rain's easing. Hold on a little longer — it's nearly light.
radio.o8a: We got that message again. Word for word.
radio.o8b: Only this time, it's signed by her sister.
radio.replyHello: Hello, Harbor Mart. Leave the light on for the rest of us.
radio.replyRain: Stopped here a minute ago. It'll stop where you are too.
radio.replyThanks: That's what we're here for. You too, you know.
radio.signoff: This is Night Ferry. It's morning. Good night.
radio.taxi1: Car six, are you there? Fare at the pier, going nowhere in particular.
radio.taxi2: ...Car six. Your meter's been running since midnight.
radio.taxi3: Nobody's called it in, Walt. Just keep driving.
radio.tuningHint: A few of you say our signal keeps bumping into the taxi dispatch, just up the dial. Sorry, car six. We'll share.
radio.tuningNudge: Still getting the taxis up the dial, by the way. And the hospital's pager now, if you go a little further. Busy night for everyone.
radio.ward1: (a call bell) ...Bed nine. Bed nine again.
radio.ward2: Ana, you were due off at eleven. You're still on the board.
radio.ward3: (the bell once more, a long way down the corridor)
